name: hud_cmd_binding_entry_delete_and_return_null
description: HudCmdBindingEntry::DeleteAndReturnNull frees an optional owned display string, deletes a non-null entry, and returns null.
known_limits: tier S verification is accepted by the hud_cmd_binding_entry_destructors VC target.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40bf20 loads the entry argument, skips null, frees displayText when non-null, clears displayText, operator-deletes the entry, then returns 0.
Native smoke verifies DeleteAndReturnNull returns null for both non-null and null entries while exercising the owned-string cleanup path.
tier_s_evidence: After moving the no-standalone HudCmdBindingEntry destructor body inline into the class, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /MD /O2 /Ob1 /GX /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?DeleteAndReturnNull@HudCmdBindingEntry@@SGPAU1@PAU1@@Z at 0x40bf20 matches with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 8 relocation bytes and trimming 2 NOPs; Binary Ninja body is 46 bytes and the VC object symbol is 48 bytes.
